title: AI²机器人郭彦东：开源AlphaBrain，机器人智能如何加速？
speaker: Guo Yendong

segments.en: Yeah, exactly. So, your foundational model you're talking about is alpha brain.
segments.zh: 对，没错。你提到的基础模型是AlphaBrain。

segments.en: Yep. And we've heard, you know, from Unitries, Wang Xingxing talk about the advancements in artificial general intelligence might be coming much faster
segments.zh: 是的。我们从Unitree的王兴兴那里听说，通用人工智能的进展可能比我们预期的要快得多。

segments.en: than we ever expected. Would you agree with that? Yeah, I think things grow faster and faster.
segments.zh: 你同意吗？是的，我认为事情发展得越来越快。

segments.en: Typically, people write codes all by themselves, but these days, a lot of engineers leverage large foundation model to write code.
segments.zh: 通常，人们自己写代码，但如今，许多工程师利用大基础模型来写代码。

segments.en: I think a lot of things get in faster and faster. And in the year 2000-23, I think we are one of the first companies who actually invent this large foundation model for robotics.
segments.zh: 我认为很多事情发展得越来越快。在2023年，我们是首批真正为机器人发明这种大基础模型的公司之一。

segments.en: And we keep innovating. We keep publishing papers, we keep applying for patents.
segments.zh: 我们持续创新。我们不断发表论文，不断申请专利。

segments.en: And we open source the large foundation model we call that alpha brain.
segments.zh: 我们开源了名为AlphaBrain的大基础模型。

segments.en: So that many people can use our alpha brain to make their robot smarter and smarter.
segments.zh: 这样许多人就能用我们的AlphaBrain让他们的机器人越来越智能。

segments.en: What do you think commercialization really hasn't taken off yet?
segments.zh: 你认为商业化为什么还没有真正起飞？
